releaseNotes:
• AdBlock Shield: High-performance blocking of intrusive ads, popups, and web telemetry in floating browser.
• Background Audio Playback: Seamless streaming of YouTube and web media when minimized to bubble or device is locked.
• Ghost Mode: Semi-transparent overlay with full touch pass-through for games and background workflows.
• Media Sniffer & Downloader: Direct detection of audio/video streams with instant download to system storage.
• Dual Floating Windows: Support for running multiple independent floating windows simultaneously.
• Sidebar Flashlight Tool: Fast one-tap torch toggle integrated directly into the edge dock.
• All-Apps Drawer: Search and launch any installed application directly from the floating handle.
